# scaling_user (Data Source)

Looks up a user by email and exposes their id, so a configuration can resolve a user to an id — for example to populate an on-call schedule layer's participant_ids.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve a user by email to their id, for use in fields that reference users
# such as an on-call schedule layer's participant_ids.
data "scaling_user" "lead" {
  email = "lead@example.com"
}

resource "scaling_oncall_schedule" "primary" {
  name     = "Primary On-Call"
  timezone = "Europe/London"
}

# data.scaling_user.lead.id can now be passed wherever a user id is required.
output "lead_user_id" {
  value = data.scaling_user.lead.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the user to look up. Must match exactly one user in the organization.

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String) The user's first name, or null if unknown.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the matched user.
- `last_name` (String) The user's last name, or null if unknown.
